name: 22182 · Vienna, VA
findings: ZIP 22182 (Vienna) has 243 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 92 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22182 (Vienna) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22182 (Vienna) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 92 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
